name: Pastey
description: A lightweight, self-hosted paste platform (Pastebin alternative) with language detection and on-disk encryption.

variables.name: PASTEY_RESTRICT_PASTING
variables.description: Enable/disable restricting of pasting to whitelisted users.

variables.name: PASTEY_RESTRICT_RAW_PASTING
variables.description: Enable/disable restricting of pasting via /raw to whitelisted users.

variables.name: PASTEY_RATE_LIMIT
variables.description: Rate limit for pasting, for non-whitelisted users.

variables.name: PASTEY_RECENT_PASTES
variables.description: Number of recent pastes to show on the home page.

variables.name: PASTEY_BEHIND_PROXY
variables.description: Inform Pastey if it is behind a reverse proxy (nginx, etc.). If this is the case, it will rely on HTTP headers X-Real-IP or X-Forwarded-For. NOTE: Make sure your proxy config sets these values.

variables.name: PASTEY_USE_WHITELIST
variables.description: Enable/disable whitelisting for admin tasks (view recent, delete, config).

variables.name: PASTEY_WHITELIST_CIDR
variables.description: List of whitelisted IP addresses or networks (in CIDR format).

variables.name: PASTEY_GUESS_THRESHOLD
variables.description: Threshold for automatic language detection guesses. If a result is below this value, it is treated as Plaintext.
